title: Tamil Nadu Paddy / Rice (Stock Limit) Control Order, 2026
issued_by: Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
reference_number: G.O.Ms.No.93, Co-operation, Food and Consumer Protection (B1), 13 November 2026; Notification No. II(1)/CFCP/23(h)/2026
says: Tamil Nadu has set limits on how much paddy or rice traders and millers can hold, up to 31 January 2027. For example, a wholesaler can hold 2000 metric tonnes and a retailer 8 metric tonnes for each shop.
what_to_do: Traders must declare their paddy / rice stock on the Department of Consumer Affairs portal (fcainfoweb.nic.in/psp) and keep it updated. Anyone holding more than the limit must bring the stock down to the limit.
by_when: Stock above the limit had to be brought down by 16 November 2026. The limits apply up to 31 January 2027.
who_it_affects: Paddy and rice wholesalers, retailers, big chain retail shops, millers, importers and processors across Tamil Nadu.

gaps: The order does not state a penalty, so if_not is null (it is made under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955, but the penalty is not in this text).
The 16 November 2026 deadline to reduce stock had already passed when this entry was made (17 November 2026).
Ordinary households buying rice are not addressed by this order.
